antiExamples.name: No accessible name
antiExamples.reason: A dialog needs an accessible name - pass a title, or aria-label when there is no visible title.

antiExamples.name: Relying on appearance to colour the Confirm button
antiExamples.reason: appearance only colours the header status icon. Set the Confirm button's tone yourself (tone="error") so the action matches.

antiExamples.name: Using a modal for transient feedback
antiExamples.reason: Non-blocking confirmation shouldn't interrupt the user - use Toast instead of a blocking dialog.

antiExamples.name: Uncontrolled open state
antiExamples.reason: Modal Dialog is controlled - it never closes itself. Provide open state and an onClose that sets it to false.
